transparencyNote: This page discloses the trail commission Innovate Securities receives from Asset Management Companies (AMCs) for distributing Regular Plan Mutual Fund schemes, as mandated by AMFI. AMC-wise and scheme-level brokerage structures are published below as supporting disclosure documents. Category ranges are a summary only — the AMC disclosure PDFs are the authoritative source for current applicable rates.

commissionModel.heading: Our Commission Model
commissionModel.body: Trail commission from AMCs — As per the current AMC brokerage structures published on this page, Innovate Securities receives trailing commission from AMCs for Regular Plan distribution. Innovate Securities does not charge investors a separate distribution or advisory fee. If any non-trail arrangement applies for a specific product, it will be reflected in the relevant AMC disclosure document below.

investorMeaning.heading: What This Means for You as an Investor
investorMeaning.body: Commission disclosed here forms part of the scheme’s Total Expense Ratio (TER) and is deducted from the fund’s NAV — it is not billed to you as a separate fee by Innovate Securities. TER, commission rates, and applicable arrangements can vary by scheme, plan, AUM slab, and distributor arrangement. Therefore, the TER applicable through one Regular Plan distributor may not always be identical to that applicable through another. Please verify the current TER and expense structure of any scheme on the concerned AMC website or at amfiindia.com before investing.

cards.title: Recommendations Based on Suitability
cards.body: All fund recommendations are based strictly on your risk profile, financial goals, and investment horizon — never on commission rates received from AMCs.

cards.title: No Hidden Charges
cards.body: There are no hidden charges, transaction fees, or advisory fees charged to you beyond what is disclosed on this page. What you see is what you get.

cards.title: No Non-Cash Benefits
cards.body: We do not receive any non-cash benefits, gifts, sponsored trips, or incentives from any AMC that could create a conflict of interest in our recommendations.

cards.title: CAS Transparency
cards.body: The exact commission earned by Innovate Securities on your investments is visible in your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) from CAMS, KFintech, or MF Central.

cards.title: Direct Plan Option
cards.body: Direct Plans are available at lower expense ratios through AMC portals. Innovate Securities does not facilitate Direct Plan investments; you may invest in Direct Plans independently if you prefer.

cards.title: Quarterly Updates
cards.body: This commission disclosure is reviewed periodically. Effective-from and last-reviewed dates are shown on this page, and supporting AMC brokerage sheets are retained and published for the empanelled AMCs listed above.

prohibited.heading: Practices We Strictly Prohibit
items: Recommending schemes based on higher commission rates instead of investor suitability
Accepting undisclosed upfront commissions or concealing any commission arrangement that is not reflected in the AMC brokerage disclosures published on this page
Receiving non-cash benefits, gifts, or incentives from any AMC
Splitting investor applications to earn higher transaction charges
Concealing commission information from investors when asked

onDemand.heading: How to Use This Disclosure
paragraphs: For AMC-wise and scheme-level commission details, open the relevant PDF under Empanelled AMCs & Commission Disclosures above. Those documents are the complete public disclosure for the AMCs listed.

As an investor, you have the right to know the commission earned by Innovate Securities on any specific scheme. You can also verify commissions credited on your investments in your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS).
For queries about a specific disclosure PDF or scheme rate shown in a brokerage sheet, write to Mfinnovate@gmail.com or call +91 98795 06993.
